entries.basis: Three independent viewing reviews of James Gunn’s Superman (2025), not the 1978 film or Superman Returns. William Bibbiani, Richard Brody and Michael Balderston original publisher articles opened. New Yorker original web byline July 10 is distinguished from July 21 print issue/URL. Positive and critical excerpts retained; editorial sentiment estimates concern the quoted verdicts.
